Team Members

Faculty

Li Guyue

Associate Professor and Ph.D. Supervisor at the School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Southeast University. He received his Ph.D. from Southeast University in 2017, supervised by Professor Hu Aiqun. In 2014, he was funded by the EU FP7 project to visit Tampere University of Technology, and in 2019, he was funded by the Sino-French Cai Yuanpei Program for a short visit to ESIEE PARIS. He was consecutively named a “Stanford Top 2% Scientist” in 2024 and 2025. His current research interests include Physical Layer Security, wireless communication security, and IoT security. He is an IEEE member, a member of the China Computer Federation, a senior member of the China Institute of Communications, and a member of the Jiangsu Provincial Cyber Security Association. He serves as an Associate Editor for IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security, an Associate Editor for the international SCI journal EURASIP Journal on Wireless Communications and Networking (EJWCN), an Editor for IEEE Communications Letters, and a co-chair of the Physical Layer Security Workshop at IEEE VTC2021, 2022, and 2023-Fall. As the first/corresponding author, he has published over 30 papers in top international journals and conferences such as IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security, IEEE Transactions on Communications, IEEE Wireless Communications, and IEEE INFOCOM. He currently leads two projects funded by the National Natural Science Foundation of China, one project under the Regional Joint Fund, one sub-project under the National Key Research and Development Program, one project under the Jiangsu Provincial Natural Science Foundation, and several enterprise joint projects. He has received honors including the URSI Young Scientist Award from the International Union of Radio Science in 2022, the Young Science and Technology Award from the Jiangsu Provincial Cyber Security Association in 2022, and the “Zhishan Young Scholar” Talent Program (Levels A and B) at Southeast University.

    Ph.D. Students

    A 2023-grade Ph.D. student, focusing on Physical Layer Security and RF Fingerprinting. Currently conducting research on device identification methods based on RF Fingerprinting in 5G mobile communication scenarios.

Focused on Wi-Fi sensing security, he has published papers as the first author in Computers & Security and Computer Networks. As a core member, he has participated in open projects of the Key Laboratory of the Ministry of Education and two laboratory projects under the Jiangsu Provincial Frontier Technology R&D Program, and has been funded by the 2026 Southeast University Ph.D. Student Innovation Capability Enhancement Program.
